page-hero.text: About the Organizer
PT Seesion Exhibition Indonesia, part of Shixin International Exhibition Group.

organizer-intro.text: PT Seesion Exhibition Indonesia (referred to as "Seesion Indonesia") is headquartered in the core business district of Jakarta and serves as an important implementation platform for the globalization strategy of Shixin International Exhibition Group. Relying on the 26-year professional accumulation of its parent company (founded in 1998), Seesion Indonesia has established an international exhibition service system covering core fields such as energy and mining, animal husbandry, agriculture, and mechanical industry, forming a unique operation model of "driving industrial upgrading through professional exhibition clusters".
Parent company founded — 26 years of professional exhibition experience
Government agencies and business associations as partners
Awarded **“Top Ten Brand Exhibition Organizers in China”** by the China Convention and Exhibition Society (CCES).
Recognized by the **Ministry of Commerce of China** as one of the first batch of key contact enterprises in the exhibition industry.

organizer-track-record.text: From May 15–17, 2025, the 2025 Indonesia Coal and Energy Expo (ICEE 2025), organized by Seesion Indonesia, will grandly open at the Jakarta International Exhibition Center. This exhibition is planned to cover an area of 20,000 square meters and is expected to attract over 500 domestic and international energy equipment enterprises to participate. The number of professional visitors is projected to exceed 20,000, showcasing the latest technologies and innovative solutions in coal mining, clean energy, energy chemicals, and other fields. During the exhibition, multiple high-end forums such as the China-Indonesia Coal Supply Chain and Coal Chemical Industry Cooperation Conference and the China-Indonesia Renewable Energy Industry Cooperation Conference will be held, establishing an in-depth integration platform connecting government, industry, academia, research, and practitioners.
Partnership with the Indonesian Coal Mining Association

To deepen international energy cooperation, Seesion Indonesia signed a strategic cooperation memorandum with the Indonesian Coal Mining Association on March 19, 2025, establishing a long-term cooperation mechanism in areas such as information sharing, market expansion, technical exchanges and exhibition promotion. By integrating energy industry resources of China and Indonesia, the two sides are committed to building an industry exchange platform with international influence, promoting technological innovation and industrial upgrading in the Indonesian and global energy markets.

As an accelerator for industrial upgrading in Southeast Asia, Seesion Indonesia will continue to deepen the "professional exhibition curation, industrial operation, and global connection" tripartite service model, continuously providing high-quality exhibition services for enterprises in different fields globally, and striving to become the core hub connecting industrial resources between China and ASEAN, promoting high-quality economic development in the region.

indonesia-advantages.text: Indonesia is the largest economy in Southeast Asia, with a total GDP of 22,139 trillion Indonesian rupiah (about 1.39 trillion US dollars) in 2024, accounting for more than 1/3 of Southeast Asia's total GDP. It has abundant natural resources and a diversified industrial structure.

Indonesia boasts unique traditional arts, music, and dances, which vividly reflect the harmonious integration of diverse ethnic groups and religions. Meanwhile, it has been continuously advancing the development in the fields of education, health, and social security. Through systematic measures, it promotes the upgrading of relevant services, providing a solid guarantee for improving people's livelihood.

Indonesia is the world's largest coal exporter and third-largest coal producer, with rich coal reserves of about 40 billion tons (China's coal reserves are about 218.5 billion tons), accounting for 3.2% of the world's total reserves, ranking seventh in the world. Indonesia's coal is of good quality and high calorific value, mainly distributed in Sumatra, Kalimantan and other regions, providing important support for the local economy.

indonesia-a-core-hub-in-the.text: Indonesia — A Core Hub in the *Global Mining Landscape*

indonesia-a-core-hub-in-the.alt: Aerial view of a large industrial mineral processing complex

indonesia-a-core-hub-in-the.text: MINING & DOWNSTREAM INDUSTRIES**Turning resources into new possibilities.**

In recent years, the Indonesian government has continued to advance its mineral downstreaming strategy, including export restrictions on raw nickel, bauxite and tin concentrates and requirements for domestic smelting and processing. This has rapidly increased demand for smelting, beneficiation and deep-processing equipment. At the same time, mining areas are accelerating electrification and intelligent transformation, with photovoltaic microgrids and heavy-equipment electrification projects being deployed in major mining regions such as Sulawesi and Kalimantan. Indonesia's annual mining-equipment market has reached approximately US$2.5 billion, with continuing growth in demand for smart mining, green-mine construction and downstream processing equipment.
Source: organizer market overview (concept data — to be verified before publication).

a-world-of.text: / EXHIBITION SCOPE
EIGHT INDUSTRY CATEGORIES
A world of
opportunity.
From extraction at the source to applications that create new value. Explore the sectors represented at the exhibition.
**Mining Extraction Equipment & Technology**Mining machinery, drilling, hauling and underground solutions
Full-process equipment for open-pit and underground mining, including excavators, haulage trucks, loaders, roadheaders, drill rigs and material transport systems.
**Mineral Processing & Beneficiation**Crushing, grinding, screening and separation technologies
Processing and beneficiation equipment for crushing, grinding, classification, screening, flotation, filtration and material-handling operations.
**Metallurgy & Deep Processing**Smelting, refining, casting and high-value processing
Furnaces, converters, kilns, refining and smelting systems, metallurgy solutions, casting, rolling, heat treatment and advanced manufacturing.
**Downstream Materials & Applications**Nickel, copper, batteries and industrial applications
Nickel, copper, tin, aluminum, battery materials, stainless steel, alloys, industrial components and downstream partnership opportunities.
**Digital Intelligence & Automation**Smart mining, industrial data and automation
Digital intelligence, industrial IoT, monitoring, connected systems and automation. Details subject to organizer confirmation.
**Safety, Environment & Green Mining**Safer, cleaner and more sustainable operations
Safety equipment, environmental protection, green mine management and responsible operations. Details subject to organizer confirmation.
**Supporting Equipment & Consumables**Components, spare parts and critical support systems
Supporting equipment, spare parts, consumables and technologies for mining and downstream industrial facilities.
**Exploration, Engineering & Investment**Testing, services, financing and partnerships
Exploration, testing, project engineering, services and investment or financing support for the mining value chain.

JAKARTA INTERNATIONAL EXPO (JIEXPO), KEMAYORAN
HOME OF INDONESIA MINING & DOWNSTREAM INDUSTRIES EXHIBITION 2027

Jakarta International Expo (JIExpo) Kemayoran is located strategically in the heart of Jakarta, offering exceptional accessibility that makes it Indonesia’s premier destination for massive international trade shows, concerts, and conventions.

The landmark brings together thousands of industry professionals, exhibitors and buyers to accelerate networking and business opportunities. The venue offers familiarity amongst the food and beverage industry, with business facilitation, easy transportation access and spacious parking area.
Jakarta International Expo (JIExpo) Kemayoran is one of the leading venues in Jakarta, and provide the best solution for Meetings Convention Conference Exhibition (MICE) in Indonesia.

JIExpo Kemayoran has an area up to 44 hectares, with 100,000 sqm exhibition area, consist of 50,000 sqm of indoor and more than 50,000 sqm of open space or outdoor area. Over the years, JIEXPO has hosted various exhibitions and events across multi sectors.

questions.text: When and where will the event be held?
Indonesia Mining & Downstream Industries Exhibition 2027 is scheduled for 26–28 May 2027 at JIEXPO, Jakarta, Indonesia.
Can I request a specific booth size?

Yes. Sign in, choose preferred available units on the published floorplan and enter the area you need in m². Your selection is a request only — the organizer confirms the final booth, area and quotation.
How do I register for a conference?
Create a verified account and select a published conference. Paid bookings use a manually issued invoice and organizer-confirmed bank transfer.
Are payments available on this website?
Paid conference and booth bookings use organizer-issued invoices and manual bank transfers. Finance confirms payments in CMS; no automatic checkout is available.

questions-we-ve-got-you.text: Find quick answers to common questions about visiting IMDX 2027.
Is there a registration fee to visit IMDX 2027?
Visitor registration is free of charge. Please register online in advance to receive your visitor pass and the latest event updates.
How do I register as a visitor?

Click “Register as Visitor”, create your account with your email address, and complete the visitor registration in your account. Your personal QR visitor pass is issued after your registration is confirmed.
Where is the exhibition venue and how do I get there?
IMDX 2027 takes place at JIEXPO Kemayoran, Jakarta, Indonesia. See The Venue page for the location, access and getting-there information.
What can I expect at IMDX 2027?
Three days of exhibition, conferences and networking across the mining, mineral processing, metallurgy and downstream value chain.

IMDX 2027 is a business-to-business exhibition for industry professionals: mining and processing companies, government and associations, investors, engineers, buyers and other stakeholders of the mining and energy sector.
Register now to get your visitor pass, receive the latest updates, and be part of Indonesia's leading mining and energy exhibition.
